messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> PD#INC-4821: elevated 5xx rate on inference-gateway-usw2 (threshold 2% -> current 8%). Autopage chain fired.

pagerbot: page sent to oncall rotation (oncall-sre). Escalation timer 3m. Links: https://pd.company/INC-4821 , runbook: https://go/runbooks/inference-5xx

oncall-sre (alex): Acked. I'm looking at the gateway dashboards now. @sam can you drop into ingress logs?

sam: on it, pulling logs for last 5m. seeing a spike of upstream 502s from auth-proxy pool. Snippet:
```
2026-03-16T22:33:05Z inference-gateway us-west-2 502 upstream_reset id=abc123
2026-03-16T22:33:08Z inference-gateway us-west-2 502 upstream_timeout id=abc127
```

megan: I see backend pods 502-ing during deploy window, but k8s events look normal. No recent config changes in the last 10m.

carlos: Can we verify if a canary rollout is still in progress? last rollout @ 22:20 UTC. If canary node pool overloaded, we should divert traffic.

oncall-sre (alex): Confirmed: canary rollout for model-router v2.3.1 happened at 22:18. Traffic weight 10% -> 50% over ~5m per rollout policy. I'm going to flip routing to avoid canary. Doing weighted route change now.

alex: Running quick reroute: `curl -X POST https://edge-admin.local/route -d '{"path":"/v1/infer","weight":{"v2.3.1":0,"stable":100}}'` -> applied.

sam: After route change, 5xx rate dropped from 8% -> 1.6% within 40s. CPU on canary nodes was at 98% and OOM-killed one sidecar earlier. Looks like rollout overloaded a subset of auth proxies.

megan: Scaling canary down + draining node pool to avoid noisy neighbor. `kubectl scale deploy/router-canary --replicas=0 -n inference`

carlos: Also patching the auth-proxy to add a conservative timeout: `ENV AUTH_TIMEOUT=10s` for canary. Will push a patch to the canary image and re-roll after stability.

oncall-sre (alex): PD incident updated -> mitigation: traffic reroute to stable and scaled down canary. No customer-facing errors after reroute; monitoring for 10m. @lia please check customer-facing error pages and any Support tickets.

lia: Quick check of Sentry and Support queue: 3 new error reports from one customer org (app-id: ZETA) between 22:32-22:35 complaining of "upstream error". I've created a support task to follow up and set severity to P2.

sam: Logs show requests from ZETA retried ~2x then succeeded post-reroute; no obvious data loss. We'll flag for CS to confirm.

oncall-sre (alex): Marking PD incident as under control. Will keep thread open for 20m to watch for regressions. Runbook step: follow postmortem template and collect `kubectl describe` of failed pods + stack traces.

incidentbot: Autopage auto-close scheduled in 30m if no further spikes.

megan: Captured `kubectl get events` and `kubectl logs --since=15m` dumps, uploading to /internal/incidents/1736129999/artifacts.

carlos: Follow-up action: revert canary rollout and add pre-flight load-test gating to rollout job. I'll open a PR with the gating script.

oncall-sre (alex): Thanks team. Quick timeline for the postmortem: immediate RCA draft tomorrow 10:00 UTC; assign owners: sam (logs/telemetry), carlos (deploy gating), megan (infra config), lia (customer comms).

sam: final check: 5xx rate steady at 0.9% over last 5m, p99 latency normal. closing active triage. :white_check_mark:

alex: Closing incident channel; will update PD with summary and link to artifacts. Good catch on the noisy canary — we should tune rollout ramp. :thumbsup:
